$comment: The inert-identity table W31 Decision Log 1 (a) rules the fingerprint over,
as G0 proves it and G3 executes it. EVIDENCE, not a live constant: G3 commits
the tested, append-only copy beside `DEFAULT_MATERIAL_PROFILE`. This file is
what the proof in `digest-rule-proof.ts` reads, so the proof and the table
cannot disagree about what the rule drops.
THE RULE. The fingerprint is taken over the fully resolved material with
every entry below removed whose gate leaves all hold their declared identity
values. An entry with no gated leaves is an ordinary value drop: the leaf
goes when it holds its identity. An entry WITH gated leaves is a gate-group
and goes as one unit; a gated leaf's own value is never dropped on its own,
because a gated leaf has no identity of its own to be at.
WHY A GATE-GROUP IS THE PART THAT NEEDS THE UNIT CASE. A pure value drop is
injective for free: every resolved material carries every key, so two
materials with the same post-drop object agree on the dropped leaves too
(both hold the identity) and therefore agree everywhere. A gate-group drop is
NOT free — it merges every material that shares a gate at its identity
whatever the gated leaves hold — and it is sound only because the gated
leaves provably cannot reach the pixels while the gate is at its identity.
That is what `inertLawCase` names, per entry, and why the table is
append-only: a post-seal leaf's default IS its identity, forever.
WHERE THIS DIFFERS FROM THE CHARTER'S GROUPING, AND WHY. The charter's
Grounding groups `sigmaThinOffsetPx` with `sigmaSpanRefPx` as gated by the
slope. It is not: the law is
`σ = sigmaPx + max(sigmaThinOffsetPx, sigmaSlopePerSpan·(span − sigmaSpanRefPx))`,
so at slope 0 a NON-ZERO `sigmaThinOffsetPx` moves σ at every span — the
slope does not gate it. It is also not proved inert on its own at a non-zero
slope, where it is a floor on the line and a real operator. What
`w30-inert-laws.test.ts` actually proves is the pair TOGETHER: all three
leaves shipped at 0 return exactly `sigmaPx` at every span. So the σ law's
entry declares a two-leaf gate, which is stricter than the charter's shape,
reproduces the same digests, and is exactly the statement the committed unit
case makes.

entries.inertLawCase: packages/renderer-webgpu/test/w30-inert-laws.test.ts — "ships all three leaves at 0", "returns exactly sigmaPx at every span from 1 to 1000", "returns exactly sigmaPx at a zero, a negative and an enormous span", "takes no device ratio, so both scales read one width", "leaves the reach exactly where it was, at every span and every amplitude"
entries.whyGated: The pivot is multiplied by the slope, so at slope 0 no value of it can reach σ; the material's own words, `sigmaSpanRefPx`'s doc comment. The offset is NOT gated by the slope and is in the gate for that reason.

entries.law: deep = heavy + sizeHeavySecondShare·(heavy2 − heavy), heavy2 at sizeHeavySecondSigma{,2x}
entries.inertLawCase: packages/renderer-webgpu/test/w30-inert-laws.test.ts — "ships all five at 0", "asks for no second heavy width at any device ratio", "asks for none even where a profile names both widths, because the share gates it"
entries.whyGated: At share 0 the second heavy texture is not allocated, no pass is encoded and the optics pass never samples one, so the widths are unread whatever they hold — `heavyTapPlan` returns 0 on the share alone.

entries.inertLawCase: packages/renderer-webgpu/test/w30-inert-laws.test.ts — "ships all five at 0", "contributes exactly zero to kScatter at every statistic the analysis pass can read"
entries.whyGated: The reference is only ever read as a difference the gain multiplies, so at gain 0 no value of it can reach the mix. This is the entry the macOS 27 LIGHT document exercises: it declines the scatter with the gain at 0 and ships the reference at 0.03, provably inert and off any would-be standalone identity.

entries.law: colour = renormaliseToLinearLuma(mix(colour, chromaticityOf(backdrop) at colour's luma, bodyChromaRetention))
entries.inertLawCase: TO BE COMMITTED BY W31 G3 — the leaf does not exist yet. G0 names the shape and its identity (W31 X2); the case that proves the composite is bit-identical at 0, and the `test:gpu` case that the on state draws differently from off, land with the leaf.
entries.whyGated: Not gated. At retention 0 the mix's second term is multiplied by zero and `colour` leaves the composite exactly as `mix(backdrop, adapted, presentAlpha)` produced it, which is a multiplied zero in the same sense as `sigmaSlopePerSpan`.
